title: JSON Schema to describe the on disk MongoDB changesets model

_id.description: An identifier (in UUID format) to match all the changes which happened at once. Recommendation is either v4 , v1, v6 or v7 variants

ver.description: When the changeset was stored, in UTC UNIX epoch (including milliseconds)

which.description: The permanent identifiers of the affected entries

reason.description: An optional comment about this set of changes
